reports.title: Population census and estimates
reports.description: Population estimates. Population is approximately 43–45 million; the age structure is very young and rapid population growth continues to pressure per-capita outcomes.
reports._url_evidence: UNFPA World Population Dashboard country page for Afghanistan; fetched page shows total population 43,800,000 (2025) and the 0-14 / 15-64 / 65+ age structure, matching the item's 43-45 million young-age-structure description. NSIA's own site is unreachable via WebFetch.
reports._cadence_evidence: UNFPA World Population Dashboard for Afghanistan states the figures 'come from UNFPA and fellow UN agencies, and are updated annually'.

reports.title: National Accounts of Afghanistan (GDP)
reports.description: Official and compiled national accounts (GDP). The economy contracted sharply after 2021; recent fiscal years show modest real growth but per-capita outcomes remain under pressure from population growth and structural constraints.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node under constrained conditions.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.description: CPI and inflation rates. Price dynamics have moderated relative to the immediate post-2021 shock but remain sensitive to exchange-rate, import and supply conditions.
reports._url_evidence: Da Afghanistan Bank's Monthly Inflation Report series page, fetched and confirmed to list 19 named monthly inflation reports (Jan 2020 - Jul 2021); note the series stopped in July 2021 and NSIA's CPI bulletin site is unreachable via WebFetch.
reports._cadence_evidence: Page is titled 'Inflation Reports (Monthly)' and lists one report per calendar month from January 2020 to July 2021. DORMANT: the series stops at July 2021 with nothing published since, though DAB's homepage still carries an inflation figure ('Last updated: 22 July 2026').

reports.title: Da Afghanistan Bank institutional and reporting core
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management and key macro-financial statistics. Publishes exchange rates, inflation references and limited monetary series.
reports._cadence_evidence: Da Afghanistan Bank homepage is a live institutional portal - a rolling exchange-rate table ('Last updated: 18 August 2026'), an inflation figure, news items and a periodical magazine - rather than a single publication with a discrete release cycle.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated database/portal with no discrete editions. The number is the renderer convention decided 2026-08-18 (HANDOFF section 7) and applied 2026-08-19: a nominal releases_per_year so that absence keeps meaning 'one-off instrument' only - 250 encodes business-day updating (the live corpus's daily-FX convention), 365 genuinely all-days monitoring. It is a statement of continuous flow for the pulse/beam system, not a claim of counted editions - the observed reality is in _cadence_evidence.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics where available. Remittances, limited formal trade, humanitarian inflows and large informal/unrecorded flows are structural features under current conditions.
reports._notes: External-accounts node under constrained formal data and large informal flows.
reports._url_evidence: Da Afghanistan Bank External Sector Statistics page, fetched and confirmed to host 'Balance of Payments Transactions (BPM6)' and 'Net International Investment Position' files for Afghanistan; data stops at 2021.
reports._cadence_evidence: DAB External Sector Statistics page lists Balance of Payments (BPM6) and Net International Investment Position with quarterly labelling ('IIP summary Q1 2021'). DORMANT: the latest edition on the page is Q1 2021, so the quarterly cadence recorded is the one it had when running.

reports.title: Agriculture production statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture, Irrigation and Livestock
reports.description: Statistics on crop and livestock production. Agriculture is the backbone of rural livelihoods and food security; wheat is the dominant staple. Production is highly sensitive to drought, water availability and input constraints.
reports._notes: Core primary-sector production node under constrained conditions.
reports._url_evidence: MAIL reports index listing 'گزارش سالانه زراعتی' (Annual Agriculture Report) editions with per-province crop area, yield and production tables, plus separate wheat and rice production reports. Found by Grok; independently re-fetched and confirmed by Claude 2026-08-18 (index shows 1403 and 1404 annual reports, wheat 1404, rice 1404).
reports._cadence_evidence: MAIL reports page's core series is the annual agricultural report ('گزارش سالانه زراعتی'), with 1403 and 1404 editions listed; the page also carries semi-annual price reports and a seasonal crop forecast but states no frequency of its own. Most recent items dated 1405/4/27.

reports.title: Wheat production and food-gap statistics
reports.description: Focused statistics on wheat production and the structural wheat gap. Domestic production typically falls short of national demand (around 4.5–5 million tonnes vs demand near 7 million tonnes), making imports and humanitarian food assistance critical.
reports._notes: Foundational food-security crop node. Structural production deficit is a defining feature.
reports._url_evidence: FAO GIEWS Country Brief for Afghanistan (12 Jan 2026), fetched and confirmed to state 2025 wheat production of 4.5 million tonnes and cereal import requirements of 3.7 million tonnes, matching the item's wheat-gap framing.
reports._cadence_evidence: FAO GIEWS Country Brief for Afghanistan, current reference date 12-January-2026; the linked AFG_Archive.pdf lists ~18 dated editions over 2016-2025, typically one to two per year.

reports.title: Exchange-rate and afghani statistics
reports.description: Official exchange rates for the afghani against major currencies published by Da Afghanistan Bank. The rate is a central price signal for imports, remittances and domestic prices under limited formal capital flows.
reports._cadence_evidence: DAB homepage publishes the official afghani rate against USD, EUR, GBP, CHF, INR, PKR, IRR, CNY, AED and SAR, stamped 'Last updated: 18 August 2026' - a fresh rate each working day.

reports.title: Life expectancy and health outcome statistics
reports.description: Life expectancy at birth and related health indicators. Life expectancy remains among the lowest in the region; gains earlier in the century have been partially reversed. Continuously referenced in humanitarian and human-development analysis.
reports._notes: Core health-outcome densification under constrained service delivery.
reports._url_evidence: WHO country data page for Afghanistan, fetched and confirmed to publish 'Life expectancy at birth' and healthy life expectancy (HALE) by sex for Afghanistan, plus mortality and health-workforce indicators.
reports._cadence_evidence: data.who.int country overview is a live interactive data portal with per-indicator downloads; indicators carry their own data years (2018-2023) and the only date shown is an access date ('Accessed on 14 August 2026'), not a release cycle.
